name: Long March 12
location_str: Commercial LC-2 @ Wenchang Space Launch Site, CHN
slot_a_text: Commercial LC-2 is up to 6 launches this year, and 9 since its first in 2024. The pad had 22 days to reset after the last one.
slot_b_text: Rockets are mostly fuel; often over 85% of a launch vehicle's mass is propellant, leaving little room for payload.
